newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Ministers fix 1997 fish guide prices.
newsitem.headline: Ministers fix 1997 fish guide prices.

text.p: The Fisheries Council adopted without discussion on Friday 1997 guide prices for fresh and frozen fish products as well as the producer price for tuna intended for the canning industry, a statement said.
Commission proposals for cuts were generally watered down.
Guide prices are used for calculating support prices paid to fish producers for withdrawing surpluses from the market.
Among fresh products, the guide price for cod was fixed at 1,476 Ecus a tonne, compared with a proposed 1,431 Ecus and 1,506 Ecus in 1996.
Regarding frozen fish, octopus was fixed at 1,911 Ecus a tonne, compared with a proposed 1,875 Ecus and 1,803 Ecus in 1996.
The guide price of yellowfish tuna for canning was fixed at 1,204 Ecus a tonne, compared with a proposed 1,168 Ecus and 1,229 Ecus in 1996.
